summary.en: Two Coast Guard bomb experts were wounded when explosives detonated inside their Zamboanga City barracks, and two other Coast Guard members were injured in a separate blast at the same location. The Philippine Coast Guard began a five-day heightened alert for the Undas period while deploying personnel to rescue a distressed vessel in Tawi-Tawi and preparing for a large police deployment of over 72,000 personnel for the holiday. The Armed Forces of the Philippines monitored 54 Chinese vessels, including a carrier, transiting West Philippine Sea features from Oct. 20 to 26, and said the carrier passage off Mindanao was not a cause for alarm. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
